status: post-positive audit frozen before year-fixed-effect outcome access
motivation: Same-island colony pairs can have more similar observation-year coverage than between-island pairs. If pair-product magnitude varies by year, unequal year representation could create an apparent island contrast. Condition the pair-year comparison exactly on end year.
frozen_base: Use the identical colony eligibility, colony-wise growth standardization, regional-year residualization and static abundance/transition-count stratified label permutation from PALMER_ISLAND_YEAR_COHERENCE_V1.

statistic.response: Product of two regional-residualized standardized colony-growth values for every co-observed colony pair × end year.
statistic.coefficient: same_island coefficient computed after demeaning both response and same_island indicator within end year

null.type: static colony island-label permutation within the same five deterministic strata used in PALMER_ISLAND_YEAR_COHERENCE_V1
null.inference: two-sided permutation p; support also requires positive coefficient

analyses.strong_year_robustness: Both coefficients positive with two-sided p <= 0.05.

interpretation_boundaries: A positive result shows unequal observation-year coverage and year-specific pair-product baselines are insufficient to explain island coherence.
This does not control geographic distance, exact census date, observer identity, or unrecorded protocol differences.
This is a post-positive audit; no alternative year weighting or block definition may be selected after outcomes are opened.
